title: Beyond Interaction Capacity: Estimator Scaling with Recursive Models for CTR Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.37905v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Click-Through Rate prediction, a core task in recommendation and advertising systems, relies on modeling interactions among sparse categorical features. Explicit cross networks are a central paradigm for CTR prediction, and recent progress has largely come from increasing the interaction capacity of a single predictor through deeper cross networks and more expressive cross operators. We revisit whether continually increasing interaction capacity remains the most effective way to improve predictive performance, and find that its benefits quickly exhibit diminishing returns even as capacity continues to grow. This motivates a complementary scaling direction that we call estimator scaling, where additional resources are used to incorporate multiple related estimators rather than only enlarging a single predictor. Through theoretical analysis, we show that the gains from estimator scaling are governed by the amount of non-shared predictive

translated_title: 超越交互容量：基于递归模型的CTR预测估计器缩放方法
translated_abstract: 点击率预测（CTR）是推荐与广告系统中的核心任务，其依赖于对稀疏类别特征之间交互的建模。显式交叉网络是CTR预测的一种核心范式，近期的研究进展主要来自于通过更深的交叉网络和更具表达力的交叉算子来提升单一预测器的交互容量。我们重新审视了持续增加交互容量是否仍是提升预测性能的最有效方式，并发现即使容量持续增长，其收益也很快呈现边际递减。这促使我们提出一种互补的缩放方向——估计器缩放，即将额外的资源用于融合多个相关估计器，而不仅仅是扩大单一预测器。通过理论分析，我们表明估计器缩放带来的收益由非共享预测信息的数量所决定。
tldr: 该论文提出“估计器缩放”这一全新的缩放方向，通过递归模型融合多个相关估计器，突破了单一预测器交互容量扩展收益递减的瓶颈，从而有效提升CTR预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "estimator scaling" as a complementary scaling direction for CTR prediction, using recursive models to incorporate multiple related estimators and overcoming the diminishing returns of merely enlarging a single predictor's interaction capacity.
